risks.title: BMR-001 closure differs from handover
risks.control: Record erratum/regression; do not mutate history; repair prerequisite.

risks.title: BMR-002 becomes an infrastructure programme without Agent product
risks.control: Constitution, P1/P2 gates and independent anti-renaming review.

risks.title: Mission is implemented as renamed request/workflow
risks.control: Durable lifecycle, restart, waits, control, action and outcome tests.

risks.title: Duplicate committed effects on retry/crash
risks.control: Transactional Action/outbox, idempotency, fault-point tests.

risks.title: Agent self-approval or scope escalation
risks.control: Server policy, separate actors/scopes, forgery/escalation tests.

risks.title: Memory poisoning becomes durable authority
risks.control: Provenance, review, retention and poisoning tests.

risks.title: External runtime bypasses Atlas
risks.control: Proposal-only protocol, credential/tenant negative tests.

risks.title: Local experience regresses due to Cloud work
risks.control: Zero-credential journey at every relevant gate.

risks.title: Memory/test authorities reach production
risks.control: Production boot fail-closed matrix.

risks.title: Queue/worker topology creates noisy neighbours
risks.control: Partition/fairness/admission tests.

risks.title: Capacity or SLO claims are unmeasured
risks.control: Versioned workload and independently reproduced envelope.

risks.title: Backup exists but business recovery fails
risks.control: Restore plus outbox/provider/receipt reconciliation drill.

risks.title: Migration rollback loses active Missions
risks.control: Expand/contract and old/new compatibility/canary.

risks.title: Provider mocks promoted as production support
risks.control: Scoped readiness registry and independent promotion review.

risks.title: Provider credential/content leaks into evidence
risks.control: Secret manager, redaction tests, evidence scan.

risks.title: Provider eligibility or policy blocks chosen lane
risks.control: Scorecard and BLOCKED_PROVIDER state; continue other work.

risks.title: Retry storm/uncontrolled provider spend
risks.control: Retry budgets, circuit breakers, quotas and spend reservations.

risks.title: Atlas and Mirai write competing authority
risks.control: Ownership census and public control contracts.

risks.title: Unsupported compliance or residency claims
risks.control: Control/evidence/process/audit classification and claim review.

risks.title: Cross-tenant data or billing leakage
risks.control: Isolation tests across every storage/queue/export/usage boundary.

risks.title: Billing settlement diverges from runtime truth
risks.control: Canonical usage ledger and reconciliation.

risks.title: Hard spend cap races under concurrency
risks.control: Atomic reservation and overshoot tests.

risks.title: Marketplace built before safe extension model
risks.control: Extension conformance/adoption first; decision gate.

risks.title: Only founding team can adopt Atlas
risks.control: Fresh-context developer and extension cohorts.

risks.title: Production promoted without support/rollback authority
risks.control: Explicit promotion record and G9.

risks.title: Claude workers redesign or implement conflicting solutions
risks.control: Workers restricted to verification/test/review/commit.

risks.title: Chat/session compaction loses programme state
risks.control: Execution log, board, SessionStart compact hook.

risks.title: Unrelated repository work is overwritten
risks.control: Worktree census, isolated lane, no reset/clean/rebase/force-push.

risks.title: Evidence belongs to wrong commit/environment
risks.control: Evidence metadata, checksums and independent freshness review.

risks.title: External blocker stops entire programme
risks.control: Block only affected lane and continue DAG-ready work.
